department: Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering

gre_general.value: The ECE doctorate does not require the GRE General Test.
gre_general.quote: GRE General Test scores are not required.

entry_route.value: Applicants are expected to hold a bachelor's or master's degree in electrical or computer engineering or a closely related subject.
entry_route.quote: Applicants are expected to have a bachelor’s or master’s degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or a related discipline such as computer science, physics, or mathematics.

deadline.value: Fall 2027 PhD applications are due December 15, 2026; the official table prints no year.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The official programme page states no rule on needing a supervisor's agreement before admission.

funding.value: The School of Engineering says full-time PhD students often receive a tuition scholarship; the page does not say that most are funded.

also.quote: Full-time PhD students within the School of Engineering often receive a tuition scholarship.

notes: The page gives no admission-supervisor rule or stipend terms.
